standingLines.line: ◈ SYSTEM: "RATINGS DIP. The audience wants STAKES — pointed ones. A PALISADE. Stockpile 14,000 kcal, 350 wood and 60 stone. Walls make such good television. You will thank us when the teeth come."
📺 RATINGS ARE UP! The producers are pleased. New casting directives incoming — Wave 2 talent has been released into your sector.

💛 You hold Photo Album. Faces from before. Grace's wedding. Your dad asleep in the chair. The neighbor's kid with the missing tooth. The most valuable thing you own, and it weighs nothing. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)

📺 The Vigil. One night, alone on the haven wall, the lamp lit. Below in the dark, something large is circling. Hold your post until dawn. Do not abandon the light.

People die in this one. Regularly.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

Night. The haven wall. One lamp, lit. Below in the dark, something large is circling — you can see the grass move where it passes.

The System: "HOLD UNTIL DAWN. DO NOT ABANDON THE LIGHT."

The veterans who've held this wall won't say what's down there. "Just don't leave the lamp," they say. They don't say it

📺 🎙️ PLAY-BY-PLAY: And we are LIVE with a special presentation: THE FEAST! The little ones are putting flavored matter in their mouths ON PURPOSE. For joy. The file says joy.

🍖 FEAST 📺 — Franz opens the pantry wide: 4× Foraged food (dried), 5× Cattail, 1× Foraged food. Adanech, Sari, Boris eat until the fire burns low. Somebody laughs so hard they cry. For one evening, nobody is surviving — they're just together. (−1,626 kcal from the pantry) The channeled keepsake feeds the feast — the feast was the weapon, and the surge rides the fire until tomorrow's dawn, spent only when the blades are warmed. (FEAST SURGE ×1.5 armed)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.

📺 The Wrong Map. The System hands you a map to buried alien rations. Exactly one thing on it is a lie. Find the lie, find the food.

Almost nobody walks away from this one.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

A map of the valley, drawn in alien ink that moves when you aren't looking. Buried alien rations, marked with an X. Exactly one thing on the map is a lie.

You and Boris have until the light goes.

The veterans who've read its maps before just say "don't trust the blue." They won't say why.
